name: The Great Frog

prices.note: Rings collection: 223 regular-price rings, none marked down. From the 4mm Rounded Plain Band and Los Angelitos Ring (£130) to £5,800 (gold/stone pieces). Store base currency GBP (cart.js); USD at ECB 2026-10-28. Regular price = no variant with compare_at_price above price (Shopify products.json, the test product-images.mjs uses); price-zero items excluded.

notes: About: 'founded in 1972 in the heart of London by my parents, Paterson Riley and Carol Lehtonen-Riley', first shop on Carnaby Street; calls itself 'London's rock'n'roll jewellers'; orders 'processed and shipped from our London workshop'. Store description: 'handmade jewellery in London since 1972'.
US stores per About page: New York flagship on Orchard Street (Lower East Side) and Los Angeles store on Melrose Avenue (opened 2014). Also Tokyo; Dover Street Market stocks it.

Shipping: international by DHL, 1-3 days once dispatched; handmade jewellery takes about a week to make; 'Shipping, duties and taxes will be calculated at checkout and pre-paid before shipping'. Free shipping only on UK orders (£200 on delivery-returns page, £250 on shipping policy). ships_to from meta.json ships_to_countries (235 incl. US, CA, GB, AU).
Returns: online orders refundable 'within 28 days of delivery', unworn; online jewellery orders not eligible for exchange; resizing from £35.

Named products: Small Skull Ring £145; Skull & Crossbones Ring £235 ('A classic pirate symbol crafted into a Sterling Silver Ring', made to order). Ring sizes are UK letters (variant options F½ to Z+1).
